theorems.name: Submission.ltg_tau_integrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → (∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)) (b : Covector (Eucl P) k), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (fun x => θ x * ξ x b) (M ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) ∧ ∀ ω : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → tsupport ω ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (fun x => θ x * ξ x (ω x)) M (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))
